'''Bolban''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Envoy/Legends|envoy]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Makeb]], Bolban also shared her knowledge of diplomacy with others.
